basis: Seizures, encephalopathy and cerebral white-matter injury define AESD; infection is a trigger rather than evidence of direct CNS infection.
Cerebellar atrophy, developmental delay and seizures define the disorder; hypotonia does not establish primary muscle disease.
Ovarian epithelial neoplasm; reproductive-organ origin lies outside the axes.
Inherited pretibial skin blistering, scarring and nail dystrophy; oral and ocular abnormalities occur in fewer than 30%.
Breast carcinoma has no applicable organ axis; estrogen-receptor expression does not establish endocrine-organ disease.
Megalencephaly and cerebral dysmyelination with seizures, ataxia and spasticity localize the disorder to the nervous system.
Megalocornea and intellectual disability define it; scoliosis, kyphosis and limb deformities occur in 30-79%. Nonspecific immune annotation does not establish immunodeficiency.
Bacterial biofilm-mediated dental caries destroys tooth-root cementum; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Congenital transposition of the great arteries with associated structural cardiac malformation.
Psychiatric response to a stressor without intrinsic damage to an organ axis.
Congenital contractures and developmental impairment define it; strabismus occurs in 30-79%. Respiratory control abnormalities do not establish intrinsic lung damage.
Congenital hearing loss and skin/hair pigment abnormalities define it. Iris pigmentation usually preserves vision; bowel and neurologic disease affect minority subtypes.
Autonomic sympathetic dysfunction causes asymmetric sweating and flushing; these do not establish intrinsic skin damage. Ocular lesions are rare in the definition.
Tumor arises in the endocrine pancreas. Gastrin hypersecretion and associated gastrointestinal injury are not required by this concept.
Obesity is a metabolic/nutritional disorder; associated diabetes, fatty liver and cardiovascular diseases are separately diagnosed conditions.
Molecular subtype of breast carcinoma; breast lies outside the organ axes.
Name identifies skin, craniofacial/acral and brain abnormalities; ocular anomalies are also defining. Specific lesions and frequencies are unavailable.
Neoplasm originates in lymphatic vessels and is classified as a vascular neoplasm; it is not a lymphoma or immune disorder.
Disorder defined by abnormal blood platelet count or function; no additional organ damage applies across the umbrella.
Traumatic injury directly damages the peripheral nerves of the brachial plexus.
Bilateral hemorrhage directly damages the adrenal glands and causes adrenal insufficiency; associated sepsis or coagulopathy is a separate underlying condition.
Immune-mediated inflammation directly affects the ocular sclera.
Definition specifies nonsyndromic intellectual disability; developmental delay and seizures support neurologic involvement. Minor skeletal morphology does not establish damage.
Defining eyelid malformations accompany premature ovarian failure, which represents loss of gonadal endocrine function.
Renal-hepatic-pancreatic dysplasia defines it; truncus arteriosus occurs in 2/3. Femoral bowing (3/3) and pulmonary hypoplasia (1/3) omitted under cap; cardiac defects are more severe.
